record.field:
{mail}
===============
The email above contains information about a tender. Please respond with information that was found in this JSON format: {{ "case_number": str, "question_and_answer": str, "prerequisite_change": str }} If you can't find the relevant information to put in the JSON fields, please input "false". The case number for this tender should be put in this filed -> case_number. The question and answer part of the mail should be put in this filed -> question_and_answer. The changes that has been made to the tender should be put in this filed -> prerequisite_change.
===============
